title: Multiple bond domain
hints: Circle only domains on the central atom.
Treat each double bond as one direction.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Each C=O bond points to one neighbor, giving two domains and a linear geometry.
statement:
How many domains surround C in $\ce{CO2}$?

[_]{a}

explanations: This counts electron pairs separately in multiple bonds.
Carbon has no lone pair in this structure.
The O lone pairs are on other atoms.
